definitions.explanation: Full of life and activity. Describes places with many people and activity, or atmospheres that are cheerful and animated.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}はとてもにぎやかです。
にぎやかな{場所|ばしょ}が{好|す}きです。
{週末|しゅうまつ}は{駅前|えきまえ}がにぎやかになります。
examples.english: The area in front of the station becomes lively on weekends.

notes: Can be written as {賑|にぎ}やか in kanji but hiragana is common. Opposite of {静|しず}か (quiet). Has a positive connotation unlike うるさい (noisy) which is negative. Describes pleasant liveliness.
